My personality—high neuroticism and low openness—makes me anxious about abstract subjects. I prefer biology and art where there's more tangible beauty or organic patterns.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. High neuroticism means I worry a lot, and math triggers that anxiety. The fear of failure is real. Even though I have a master's degree, subjects like calculus make me feel exposed and inadequate in social settings or professional interviews.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I've tried using AI tools for tutoring. It helps because the steps are clear and repetitive, which fits my conscientiousness needs—but I find it overwhelming when explanations get too technical or abstract without emotional reassurance.

Differentiate f(x) with respect to x. Set the derivative equal to zero. Solve for x values that satisfy this condition. Substitute each x back into original function to get corresponding y coordinates. These (x,y) pairs are your stationary points.
